_doc: Config for scripts/models/process.py. Material patterns are case-insensitive regexes on part names; first match wins. rotate_deg (Blender axes) turns the user-facing side to +Z (glTF front). Colours are defaults pending Ansh's confirmation; front = the side shown in the v1 hero render (motors at top corners, centred lead screw, PSU at the bottom); v1 printer page photos show black 2020 extrusions, black/grey printed parts.
